description: DealCloud (an Intapp product) is a deal-management and CRM platform for investment banks, private equity, and M&A advisory firms, with a REST API.
access_notes: API key generation requires an existing DealCloud account with API permissions specifically enabled by an org admin, and the docs point users needing help to their 'DealCloud Customer Success Manager' -- this is an existing-enterprise-client workflow. No public pricing, free trial, or self-serve signup page was found; DealCloud is sold as enterprise software (Intapp) to investment banking/PE/M&A firms.
api_notes: Deal/company/contact records and user-management APIs, with official Python/other SDKs.
main_blocker: Enterprise-only product with no public self-serve signup; API access requires being an existing paying client with admin-enabled permissions.
